…holds the mind. He makes aspiration correctly. For unarisen wholesome dharmas to arise, he generates faith, strives, undertakes effort, firmly holds the mind, and makes aspiration purely. For arisen wholesome dharmas to remain, not to decline, to become extensive, to increase still further, and to be cultivated and become complete, he generates faith, strives, undertakes effort, firmly holds the mind, and makes aspiration correctly. He fully cultivates the basis of miraculous power endowed with the concentration of aspiration and the formation of abandonment, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the basis of miraculous power endowed with the concentration of effort and the formation of abandonment, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the basis of miraculous power endowed with the concentration of mind and the formation of abandonment, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. The concentration of investigation…

He fully cultivates the power of effort, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the power of mindfulness, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the power of concentration, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the power of wisdom, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the awakening factor of mindfulness, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment. He fully cultivates the awakening factor of discrimination of dharmas, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, perfected through relinquishment, [unclear] perfected. The awakening factor of effort, dwelling in solitude, dwelling in dispassion, dwelling in cessation, [unclear] dwelling,…
